scope: Authored direct in-reach pickup with pinned PiPER drives, rigid object proxies and privileged native observations. Shape, explicit load and mounted-tool conditions are diagnostic controls. No learned skill, tool detachment, retrieval or hardware qualification.

host.compute: CPU native simulation; browser replay needs WebGL2. No GPU required for native benchmark.

metrics.jaw_span_scope: joint7 minus joint8 slidecoordinates; nominal parallelfinger span, not a hardware measured aperture
metrics.timing_scope: CPU native model initialization, control, stepping, trace collection; excludes browser rendering and export
metrics.controller_scope: fixed authored shape-specific pickup with pinned150degree orientation; same trajectory and drive settings across tool conditions
metrics.comparison_scope: direct pickup morphology and load controls; tool absent from episode start, no tool dropping or retrieval
metrics.retention_criterion: final500ms:origin rises at least35mm above settledreference,both finger normalforces>.01N,world/rake/nonfinger robot forceeach<.01N
metrics.clearance_scope: analytic minimumworldz of collisionprimitives; reported separately, not substitute for allworldsupport check
metrics.force_scope: MuJoCo native normalforces and actuatorforce; simulation parameters are not hardware calibration
